test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
By interchanging the given two signs + and - and two numbers 17 and 216 (NOT digits), which of the following equations will be correct?

I. 10 × 216 + 17 ÷ 6 - 13 = 146

II. 7 × 216 + 41 - 17 ÷ 36 = 81
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers i.e

__
 
• + and -
 
• two numbers 17 and 216 (NOT digits)

So,

I. 10 × 17 - **216 ÷ 6**__ + 13 = 146

__**10 × 17**__ - 36 + 13 = 146

__**170 + 13**__ - 36 = 146

__**183 - 36**__ = 146

**147 ≠****146** (LHS ≠ RHS)

II. 7 × 17 - 41 + __**216 ÷ 36**__ = 81

__**7 × 17**__ - 41 + 6 = 81

__**119 + 6**__ - 41 = 81

__**125 - 41**__ = 81

**84 **≠ 81 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Here, Neither I nor II is correct.

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
